payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-10-22: second high-risk batch proposed (PR from thread 'Medication source links'). src/data/medication-source-links.json now maps 74 of 330 medicines (was 26): other anticonvulsants, gabapentinoids, oral antipsychotics, QTc-prolonging antiemetics, TCAs and other overdose-risk antidepressants, benzodiazepines and Z-drugs, buprenorphine, S8 stimulants, ketamine, propranolol and clonidine, each to its TGA PI search link, plus the WA Monitored Medicines Prescribing Code and ScriptCheckWA for stimulants, alprazolam, buprenorphine, ketamine and gabapentinoids. Also captured WA High Risk Medication Management Policy MP 0131/20 v2.0 (candidate, unmapped). Nothing renders until the owner signs. OWNER DECISION 2026-10-22: the live TGA PI search is the PI source, signed once per medicine with no fixed version (docs/decisions/2026-10-22-tga-pi-live-search-source.md), because www.ebs.tga.gov.au robots.txt disallows all automated retrieval. All 71 TGA PI records are now candidates under dateModel live_product_information. Next action: owner signs the records and the mappings (sign-off batch in the project files), then a separate adoption decision. UPDATE 2026-10-10: PR #3398 proposed WA-first sources in src/data/medication-source-links.json: wa-health-clozapine-guideline-2024 for clozapine, and the Australian Prescriber lithium article plus its correction for lithium-carbonate-ir-sr. They render nothing until the owner adopts and signs off those register records. Valproate, other anticonvulsants and QTc-risk drugs still have no proposal. UPDATE 2026-09-25: step 1 shipped in PR #3017. The medication footer no longer promises a linked source (it points to current Australian product information or the local guideline); the therapy footer points to the sources named under Source & review status. OWNER DECISION: default source per medication is the TGA Product Information, plus WA guidelines where they exist; engineering proposes, owner confirms, high-risk medicines first (clozapine, lithium, valproate and other anticonvulsants, QTc/overdose-risk drugs). Real links still need the data-model change described below. PRIOR DETAIL: /medications/[slug] has 0 anchors in <main> on all four tabs; /therapy-compass/[slug] the same. Footer on every tab: 'verify every dose and interaction against the linked source'. acamprosate states Max 1998 mg/day, a serum creatinine >120 micromol/L contraindication, Half-life 13-28.4 h and an unattributed EFFICACY: MODERATE tile; the only provenance is one prose sentence on tab 4 below the fold. Root cause: medication-records.ts:118-126 derives governance from a free-text src section with no URL or document id. /dictionary and /factsheets do this correctly. Fixing properly is a database migration plus clinical governance.
